practice.input: See two people at a bus stop and hear one natural Korean exchange about correcting a wrong-direction stop.
practice.output: Ask where to catch the bus, understand the correction, and give a short follow-up in Korean.
practice.dings: One start cue and one end cue around the finished card

card.title: The Other Bus Stop
card.situation: A rider at a bus stop asks whether this is the right direction for City Hall, learns that the stop is across the street, and checks where to cross.
card.description: Correct a wrong-direction bus stop and ask where to cross.
card.scene: A visitor with a small bag speaks with a local rider beside a bus-stop sign; the opposite stop and a crosswalk are visible across the street.
card.learnerInput: A visible street, two bus stops and a crosswalk; eight short turns in ordinary polite Korean.
card.expectedOutput: Ask if the bus for City Hall leaves from this stop, then clarify where to board after hearing that the direction is wrong.

lines.speaker: soyeon
lines.ko: 저기요, 시청 가는 버스 여기서 타요?
lines.en: Excuse me, do I catch the bus to City Hall here?

lines.speaker: minjun
lines.en: No, this stop is for the opposite direction.

lines.speaker: soyeon
lines.en: Oh, then where should I catch it?

lines.speaker: minjun
lines.en: You can catch it at the stop across the street.

lines.speaker: soyeon
lines.ko: 제가 반대로 왔네요. 저 앞에서 건너면 돼요?
lines.en: I came to the wrong side. Can I cross up ahead?

lines.speaker: minjun
lines.en: Yes. Cross at the crosswalk; the stop is just to your right.

lines.speaker: soyeon
lines.en: Thank you. Is it the same bus number?

variationPrompt.en: You now need the bus to the train station, but you are unsure about the direction. Ask someone at the stop where to board.
variationPrompt.ko: 이번에는 기차역에 가야 하는데 방향이 헷갈립니다. 정류장에 있는 사람에게 어디서 타야 하는지 물어보세요.
variationPrompt.sampleAnswerHidden: 저기요, 기차역 가는 버스는 어디서 타야 해요?

card.artworkBrief: Warm, contemporary Korean street illustration. A female visitor and male local rider talk beside a bus stop, with a clearly visible crosswalk and opposite-side bus stop. No readable route numbers, signs, letters, or logos.

learningNotes.purpose: Practical public-transport direction repair, not a TOPIK exam item.
learningNotes.targetConstruction: 어디서 타야 해요? / 건너면 돼요? / 타시면 돼요
learningNotes.retainedCore: Ask where to board a bus and confirm the corrected location.
learningNotes.variationOpportunity: Change the destination and ask the same direction question without a model.
learningNotes.independentProductionPrompt: At the wrong-side stop, ask a local rider where to board the bus to the train station.
